purpose: Document first-party local cadastral/map custody and bounded anonymous service review.
assessment: The Government of Bihar Department of Revenue and Land Reforms links BhuNaksha as its public revenue-map service. The official BhuNaksha Bihar application identifies the Directorate of Land Records & Survey and NIC, exposes a public seven-level cadastral selector, and returned Khagaria district/subdivision/circle metadata anonymously. No full parcel polygon was retained because the bounded pass did not resolve a verified mauza/sheet GIS context for the exact WUP coordinate.
registryAssessment: Local/state cadastral custody is evidenced by the official Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms portal and the Directorate of Land Records & Survey BhuNaksha viewer. This is a Bihar state cadastral/map service with Khagaria selectors; no separate Khagaria municipal registry endpoint was evidenced.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Bihar Department of Revenue and Land Reforms portal links BhuNaksha and other land-record services.
Official Bihar BhuNaksha viewer states it is cadastral mapping software for digitized cadastral maps and identifies the Directorate of Land Records & Survey, Government of Bihar, and NIC.
Official Khagaria district site provides district/block maps; it is contextual administrative mapping, not parcel-vector evidence.
